description_en: Sets the maximum available bandwidth for an EIP that has been added to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth接口为已经加入到共享带宽的EIP设置最大可用带宽值
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-common-bandwidth-package-ip-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2zep6hw5d6y8exscd0000 --eip-id eip-2zewysoansu0svfbg0000 --bandwidth 500 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 共享带宽所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the EIP that has been added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.help_zh: 已经加入到共享带宽的EIP的实例ID
parameters.name: eip_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum bandwidth that can be allocated within the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Unit: Mbps
parameters.help_zh: 在共享带宽内最大可分配的带宽值。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth
